name: ZX_DEFAULTING_RULE_RESULTS_F
description: This table contains tax rules that are defined to evaluate the default values of the tax determinants for quick rule processing.

columns.name: DEFAULTING_RULE_RESULT_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier for the defaulting rule record.

columns.name: APPLICATION_ID
columns.description: Identifier of a functional area within a software suite of products. For example: Financials or Payroll.

columns.name: TAX_EVENT_CLASS_CODE
columns.description: Groups the application event classes that are essentially the same from a tax perspective such as receivables invoice, on-account credit memo, etc.

columns.name: EVENT_CLASS_CODE
columns.description: Application event class code associated with the tax rule.

columns.name: INTERNAL_ORGANIZATION_ID
columns.description: Internal organization location identifier of the transaction.

columns.name: DET_FACTOR_TEMPL_CODE
columns.description: Determining factor template code used to evaluate the tax rule.

columns.name: PRIORITY
columns.description: Priority in which this tax rule is evaluated for the tax determination process.

columns.name: ENABLED_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether the tax rule is enabled for processing. Valid values: Y and N.

columns.name: LE_COUNTRY_CODE
columns.description: Code of the country associated with the legal entity of the transaction.

columns.name: BU_COUNTRY_CODE
columns.description: Code of the country associated with the business unit of the transaction.

columns.name: EFFECTIVE_START_DATE
columns.description: Date Effective Entity: indicates the date at the beginning of the date range within which the row is effective.

columns.name: EFFECTIVE_END_DATE
columns.description: Date Effective Entity: indicates the date at the end of the date range within which the row is effective.

columns.name: CONTENT_OWNER_ID
columns.description: Party tax profile identifier for the configuration owner of this tax rule.

columns.name: RECORD_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Code to indicate whether the record is migrated, seeded, or defined by the user.

columns.name: SERVICE_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Default value for the rule type code.

columns.name: NUMERIC_RESULT
columns.description: Numeric value of the result from the tax determination process.

columns.name: ALPHANUMERIC_RESULT
columns.description: Alphanumeric result value from the tax determination process.

columns.name: DETERMINING_FACTOR_CODE1
columns.description: Determining factor code for the first condition.

columns.name: DETERMINING_FACTOR_CQ1_CODE
columns.description: Determining factor class qualifier code for the first condition. This is a subclassification of the determining factor class.

columns.name: OPERATOR1_CODE
columns.description: Operator used for defining the first condition. Valid values: =, <>, =CQ, <>CQ, and BETWEEN. = means the value is equal to the condition. <> means the value is not equal to the condition. =CQ means the value is equal to the class qualifier. <>CQ means the value is not equal to the class qualifier. BETWEEN means the value is between the condition values.

columns.name: NUMERIC_VALUE1
columns.description: Numeric value to be compared with the determining factor of the first condition.

columns.name: ALPHANUMERIC_VALUE1
columns.description: Alphanumeric value to be compared with the determining factor of the first condition.

columns.name: VALUE_LOW1
columns.description: Lowest value in the range to be compared with the determining factor for the first condition, when the operator is BETWEEN.

columns.name: VALUE_HIGH1
columns.description: Highest value in the range to be compared with the determining factor for the first condition, when the operator is BETWEEN.
